note: Ray County's parcel layer (Ray_Assessor_Data MapServer on services2.integritygis.com) returns 'Token Required' for the service root and layer 0, so it is not publicly queryable. The assessor site lists GIS Mapping only as a paid subscription feature. Commercial parcel vendors (Regrid, uslandgrid, ReportAll, Acres) are paid, not county-published. No public county parcel FeatureServer/MapServer or downloadable file was found in ArcGIS Hub/Online searches.
